# Data Center Policy Tracker

> A sourced public record of data-center policy — what governments, utilities and residents have done, and what operators have promised host communities — in the US and selected countries. Every record links to its primary source and carries a capture date; company statements are quoted verbatim.

Last refreshed 2026-11-10. Record counts: 191 sites (58 contested), 17 companies, 353 moratoriums (304 enacted), 158 policies, 34 benefit agreements, 29 tariffs, 20 rate cases, 327 pledge signatories, 152 international records across 17 countries.

## Sections

- [Home](https://pranava0x0.github.io/datacenterpolicytracker/#overview): Section totals, the latest actions and dated upcoming decisions.
- [Elections](https://pranava0x0.github.io/datacenterpolicytracker/#elections): Incoming and prior officeholders' data-center policies, proposed changes, and local ballot measures.
- [The Pledge](https://pranava0x0.github.io/datacenterpolicytracker/#ratepayer): The White House Ratepayer Protection Pledge: its five commitments (quoted), every signatory, and a per-site scorecard.
- [Policy](https://pranava0x0.github.io/datacenterpolicytracker/#policies): Laws, bills, executive orders, local rules and community benefit agreements.
- [Moratoriums](https://pranava0x0.github.io/datacenterpolicytracker/#moratoriums): Enacted, proposed, lifted and failed restrictions, with a searchable directory, map and trends.
- [Power Costs](https://pranava0x0.github.io/datacenterpolicytracker/#tariffs): Large-load electricity tariffs scored against the DOE/LBL design elements, and the docketed rate cases behind them.
- [Companies](https://pranava0x0.github.io/datacenterpolicytracker/#comparison): What each operator has published about jobs, tax, energy, water, grants, infrastructure, education and engagement, with quotes.
- [Sites](https://pranava0x0.github.io/datacenterpolicytracker/#explorer): Individual data-center sites on a map, with status, claims, community responses and a dated timeline.
- [International](https://pranava0x0.github.io/datacenterpolicytracker/#world): Policies, pauses, sites and company statements outside the US, with original-language quotes and labelled translations.

## How to cite

Cite the record's own `source_url`, not this site, for any fact. Dates are event dates (the vote, filing or signing), not article dates. A missing assessment means not yet reviewed, not a finding.
